description: This file defines API endpoints for meal plan generation using FastAPI. It sets up a router with a GET endpoint '/generate' that interacts with the Spoonacular API client to generate meal plans based on query parameters.

classes.name: APIRouter
classes.description: FastAPI class used to create API route groups.

classes.name: HTTPException
classes.description: Exception for HTTP errors, used here to return error responses.

classes.name: SpoonacularClient
classes.description: Client class for interacting with Spoonacular's API.

classes.name: SpoonacularError
classes.description: Exception class representing errors from Spoonacular API.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] generate_meal_plan( time_frame: str = Query("day", pattern="^(day|week)$", description="Timeframe to generate meal plan for: day or week"), target_calories: Optional[int] = Query(None, ge=800, le=5000, description="Target daily calories"), diet: Optional[str] = Query(None, description="Dietary preference (e.g., vegetarian, keto)"), exclude: Optional[str] = Query(None, description="Comma-separated ingredients to exclude"), client: SpoonacularClient = Depends(get_spoonacular_client), )
methods.description: Function to generate a meal plan based on provided parameters, handling exceptions from the Spoonacular API.
